properties.text: Ukrainian forces recently advanced in the Kupyansk and Slovyansk directions.

Ukrainian forces recently advanced east of Novoselivka (northwest of Lyman) according to geolocated footage published on August 29.[28] A source reporting on the Russian Western GoF claimed that the Lyman direction has become more dynamic following a series of Ukrainian counterattacks in the area.[29] Russian forces continue infiltration missions in the Kostyantynivka-Druzhkivka tactical area.

A Russian milblogger claimed on August 28 that Russian forces advanced west of Charivne (east of Orikhiv), north of Novodanylivka (southeast of Orikhiv), and into central Bilohirya (southeast of Orikhiv).[67] Ukrainian forces continued their intermediate-range strike campaign against Russian military assets in occupied Zaporizhia Oblast.

ISW has not observed evidence to assess that Russian forces have a presence (either through advances or infiltrations) in Pyskunivka, Pershomarivka, or Orikhuvatkha, and that Russian forces have advanced to roughly 14 kilometers from both Slovyansk and Kramatorsk.
